title: fix(ui): show child failures and attention in parent chat
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a parent chat showing no explanation when its sidebar warning comes from a failed or blocked child session.

## User Impact

The parent chat shows the child's name, full diagnostic, and an **Open session** action above the composer, even without a new parent reply. Opening the parent preserves active child attention.

## Why This Change Was Made

The sidebar already folded child status into the parent, but chat did not render that status. Both views now share attention classification. Chat carries the admitted parent identity through route aliases and hydrates ordinary child status independently of the swarm UI setting. Notices follow the recorded read state, explicit clearing, and expiry.

## Evidence

**Dependency blocker repaired:** [PR #166217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166217) landed as `c39d9b0692dbaafa5b1bfe02514c9f6411ab5546` and is integrated in `21b052fcce875aebf1378e4ddfb488fbc6e43a0d`. The 24-file UI patch is byte-for-byte unchanged relative to the new baseline. The older [security-fast failure](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37506200161/job/112415832413) remains historical evidence; the new-head [security-fast check](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37532644331/job/112506160492) now passes. All required hosted CI is green.

**Integrated-head proof:** 177 focused UI tests, 148 sidebar caller tests, and 16 Gateway lifecycle/projection tests pass. The bundled browser reproduction passes (1/1), including its UI build and startup budgets. All scoped changed-check gates pass: eight test-type groups, UI types, guards, formatting, i18n, all three export scans, targeted lint and styles. Source/privacy checks pass. Exact-head [CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37532644331) passed (43 successful jobs, 22 intentionally skipped), and [ClawSweeper revision 2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166224#issuecomment-6022296357) has no actionable findings or remaining before-merge work. Squash-merged as `1a7f9628e785c59e7843186cc0feca0aeefe9508`.

- Browser reproduction: the baseline fails because the notice is absent; the patch passes with the full reason, wrapping text, and usable child-session action.
- Inspected synthetic before/after screenshots below.
- Focused sidebar, read-marker, child-notice, and roster tests pass, including expiry, escaping, navigation, disabled swarm, and global/custom-main aliases.
- UI build passes startup size/request budgets.
- Original-head selected changed-check gates pass: eight affected test-type groups, UI types, guards, formatting, export scans, targeted lint, and styles.
- Independent review: no remaining actionable findings.
- Original browser baseline: `8177060846209e40a506e442785a7736f31db674`; original UI patch: `1cd315394309c3a9413768aa7da0b0fa38b1e9f4`. Current integrated head: `21b052fcce875aebf1378e4ddfb488fbc6e43a0d`.

### Before

![Sidebar warning without a chat diagnostic](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/afb7961a-438f-4d84-a20c-7036975b6fc5)

### After

![Parent chat showing the child diagnostic and Open session action](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c1785721-d103-4340-9410-956921f50425)

Follow-up: the existing roster authoritatively hydrates direct children; expanding nested descendant hydration is separate work. Selected-child clear-on-open and explicit mark-as-read behavior retain their existing contracts.

Production delta: +337/-168 (net +169), providing the attributed notice and expiry lifecycle while replacing duplicated attention policy. Tests: +366/-16. Documentation: +2.
